Welcome, dear one

Welcome to our sacred ceremony hub

We are so glad you are here with us! The fact that you are reading this means you are someone we want beside us as we step into this next chapter, yay!

This website holds everything you need for the weekend. The schedule, the land, what to wear, what to bring, how to RSVP, and a glimpse into the small pockets of magic waiting for you once you arrive. There is a fair amount here, so get comfy, settle in and read through it all before you reach out. Most questions are answered somewhere on these pages, and if something is still unclear after you have wandered through, there is a contact form at the very bottom and we will happily help!

This is not a normal wedding, so we invite you to think of these pages less like an invitation and more like a doorway. Step into the world we are creating together, come on in!

The spirit of the weekend

A gathering woven with intention

✦

Why we are doing this differently

We did not want a wedding where we go through the motions while everyone patiently daydreams about dinner. We are pouring so much love and thought into every corner of this gathering, because we want it to feel like something we all step into together rather than a show you came to see.

We did not become who we are on our own. This relationship has been witnessed, held, challenged, softened, and shaped by the people around us, and many of those people are you! So this weekend is two things at once! It is a celebration of our love, and it is a thank you to the community that helped that love grow.

You are not a spectator here, you are part of the living thing we are building for these two days. Come play, rest, sing, eat, and maybe even cry with us! The magic is not something you need to perform, it is something you are invited to tap into!

Stay an hour or stay the whole weekend

We know this weekend is unconventional, and it may not be everyone's cup of tea, and that is completely okay. Some of you will want the entire two days, some of you might want to head home as soon as you finish your dinner. We will not take this personally!

Spending a full day outdoors is not everyone's idea of comfort, and we understand completely. No matter how long you show up, we are grateful you came and any amount of your presence is a gift for us!

The shape of our days

Schedule

Two days on the land. The first holds the ceremony and celebration, the second is a slow, open hearted hang. Here is how it all unfolds.

Saturday, September 12

The day of the ceremony, the feast, and a night of whimsy and play.

2:00 to 3:30 PM

Arrive and settle in

Guests must be fully arrived by 3:30 PM, but are welcome to start coming as early as 2:00. Those who plan to camp should plan to come on the earlier end so they can use that time to set up their camp spot. Any extra time can be used to explore the land, connect with friends, and get settled in and ready for the ceremony to begin.

4:30 to 6:00 PM

Wedding ceremony

Our ceremony will be more of intentionally created rituals than just a quick exchange of vows. Expect more magic and whimsy woven throughout, in ways that feel honest to who we are. PLEASE NO PHONES DURING OUR CEREMONY! Our photographer will capture all of the moments and they will be shared with you. But we do highly encourage photos and videos the rest of the weekend!

6:00 to 9:00 PM

Wedding reception

We will share a feast of a Mediterranean buffet (with vegan and gluten-free options), share toasts and stories, and enjoy each other's company!

9:00 PM and beyond

Party time!

The night opens into music from our favorite DJs and the sacred spaces (read on to learn more!) coming alive! Dancing, creative offerings, late-night cuddle puddles, and a celebration with no set ending.

A note on the night

Until 9:00 PM, this gathering is a completely sober space. After 9:00 PM, the celebration shifts into an adult evening party. Nothing extra will be provided by us, and adults are responsible for their own choices. Please be mindful in your elevated intake, care for yourself, and stay respectful of the space, the land, and one another.

After 9:00 PM

A night of whimsy + play

The party opens at 9:00 PM and has no set end time. There will be DJs and dancing, and the land stays awake as long as we do. This part of the night is participatory, so bring what makes you come alive.

Bring your magic. A few ideas:

Aerial artsFire and flow toysShibari gear InstrumentsSongs to shareDrum circle items Creative adornmentBody paintFestival-style magic Anything you would bring to a campout

Nothing is too extra.

Keeping our circle close

Because space is limited and this gathering is deeply personal to us, plus-ones are not open unless we directly asked you to bring them. We promise this is not personal. We just do not have room for everyone to bring additional guests, and we are keeping this gathering close to the relationships we already have. If your partner or guest was not specifically invited, please do not add them to your RSVP.

For the same reason, this celebration is mostly for the adults in our lives. Only children who are family, plus breastfeeding littles, are able to join us, and the RSVP will let families include them. The evening shifts into an adult party at 9:00 PM, so the earlier part of the day is the time for the children to be on the land with us.

To solve not having space for everyone's littles, plus-ones, or even some of our friends, we created an open-invite celebration a few weeks before our wedding where everyone is welcome to join! Hint: Dixon's Violin, hehe!

Learn more + RSVP here

Sunday, September 13

A soft landing

Sunday has no schedule and no plan, and that is the whole point. It is a casual day to linger on the land and stay in the love from the night before. There is no meal provided, so if you are camping or coming back for Sunday, pack your own food and snacks the way you would for a relaxed campout.

Spend the day however feels good. Swim in the river, lie in a hammock, flow, play games, work on a craft, or simply sit with friends in the afternoon light. The land will hold us for one more gentle day. Everyone needs to be off the property by 3:00 PM.

Coming only for Sunday?

Could not make Saturday but still want to come Sunday? You are welcome. There is no formal arrival time. Come any time before 3:00 PM, and know that Sunday is purely a casual hang on the land rather than a wedding event.

Where the land will hold us

Venue & Lodging

Full Circle Farms and Sanctuary

12834 Tuttle Hill Rd, Willis, Michigan 48191

Open in maps
  • A 40 acre property, with our gathering spread across roughly 15 of them.
  • The wedding is fully outdoors on both days, with no indoor guest access.
  • Restroom needs are covered by clean, comfortable luxury restroom trailers.
  • There is onsite parking, and attendants will guide you where to park when you arrive.
  • Cell service is available and GPS is reliable, so you will find us easily.
  • The driveway is easy and the terrain is gentle, with plenty of shade across the land.
  • Electricity is not available to guests, so charge up before you arrive.
  • Chairs are provided for the ceremony and main ritual spaces.

You are in the right place

Full Circle Farms and Sanctuary is also the home of our dear friends Chrissie and Eric. As you pull in, it will feel like you are arriving at someone's house, because you are. That is part of the charm. Follow the parking attendants, trust their lead, and know you have found us.

Getting from your car to the gathering

The walk from parking to the main event space is about 0.16 miles, which most guests will find an easy stroll. If you would like a lift, golf cart transportation assistance will be available, and you can let us know on the RSVP.

Rain or shine

The event happens rain or shine, and both days are outdoors. There will be a tent to gather under if the weather turns, so pack with the elements in mind and you will be just fine.

A small kindness for the chairs

If you are camping or coming back on Sunday, you may want to bring an extra camp chair or two, so the rental chairs stay in good shape for the ceremony.

Nearby places to rest your head

For those who would rather sleep in a real bed, here are a few options near the land. Please confirm availability, pricing, and drive time before you book.

Holiday Inn Express & Suites, Belleville Airport Area

46194 N. I-94 Service Drive, Belleville, MI 48111

Fairfield Inn & Suites, Ann Arbor Ypsilanti

326 James L Hart Parkway, Ypsilanti, MI 48197

There are also other good options around Belleville, Ypsilanti, Ann Arbor, and the Detroit airport area. Search for whatever sits closest to 12834 Tuttle Hill Rd, Willis, MI 48191, and book early.

What to wear

Dress Code

Come as yourself, in whatever form feels true. This is not a normal wedding, and the recommended attire is not normal wedding attire. Dress in a way that feels authentic, expressive, and good in your body.

Saturday: ceremony & reception

The vibe is whimsical, enchanted, fairy tale, and wedding-worthy. It is not super dressy, but it is not casual either. Stiff suits and ties or formal wedding attire may feel a little out of place here.

Dresses are welcome and encouraged, though please do not feel pressured into a traditional wedding look. If you feel called to fairy tale, fantasy, woodland, mythic, romantic, or magical attire, lean all the way in. If that is not your language, wear something that still feels comfortable, intentional, and true to you.

Please do not feel any pressure to go out and buy something new. An old sundress already hanging in your closet would be perfectly fitting. The more whimsical vibe is not mandatory, we just thought it would be fun for some of you, so why not?

We will not be judging anyone for how they show up. We are simply grateful you will be there.

After 9:00 PM

Bring a change of clothes. Once the party opens, slip into whatever feels good for dancing, exploring, flowing, lounging, and playing.

Festival outfitsDancewearComfortable layers Playful adornmentBody paintFace gems Fairy wingsFlow-friendly clothing

Nothing is too extra.

Colors

You are welcome to wear our wedding colors, but it is not required. More than anything, we want you to dress in a way that inspires you. We do ask that you avoid white.

Burgundy
Deep purple
Gold
Avoid white

Footwear

This is an outdoor wedding on land with trails and natural ground. Go barefoot if you feel called to it. If you are wearing shoes, outdoor-friendly footwear will serve you best. High heels may be a tricky choice out here, so if they are part of your look, bring a backup pair to change into.

Sunday

Sunday is completely casual and self-directed. A baggy T-shirt, a whimsical dress, swimwear, festival clothes, or anything in between. We love creating spaces where friends can show up completely as themselves, so wear whatever makes a relaxed day on the land feel good.

Pockets of magic across the land

Sacred Spaces

Scattered through the property are five spaces to wander into. You can explore them before the ceremony, but they truly come alive once the party begins and the night deepens. Take the lead and make them yours!

To be extra clear, no one will be stationed in these spaces directing you. The stations will be set up and ready, and this is where we invite you to be a main character and share your magic! If a space is sitting open and you have something to offer there, we encourage you to gather some folks and get it going. We are also fully open to the possibility of these spaces becoming something else if the magic of the evening has different plans for them! Listen to the whispers of the winds, and show up how you are guided!

I

Ceremony Triangle

The heart of the land, where most of our ceremonies and rituals will unfold. This is the place we gather to make our vows.

II

Song Circle

A space of connecting through the gift of sound! Bring instruments and songs you want to share. Sing to the land and to one another, letting music become part of the living magic of the weekend!

III

Story Square

A place to share tales, both real and make-believe. Storytelling is an ancient way of drawing people together, and we do not want that tradition to fade. Bring a short story to share, whether personal, mythic, or original. You might even play a game where everyone builds a story together, one piece at a time!

IV

Temple of Devotion

A space to care for and love on one another. Feed each other fruit, fan one another, offer small acts of service, gentle affection, and reverent, loving presence. Tend to your people here.

V · HIDDEN

Magical Mystery Space

A hidden surprise space that only opens after 9:00 PM. We will not spoil what waits inside. Those curious about its whimsy can either stumble upon it during the after-party, or find one of us to inquire.

If you are staying the night

Camping & Packing

The camping details

  • Camping is optional, and only Saturday night is available.
  • There is no Friday or Sunday overnight.
  • You may tent camp or vehicle camp. RVs count as vehicle camping.
  • There is no glamping.
  • Pets are not allowed.

For day guests

  • Backup shoes if you are wearing heels
  • Layers for changing weather
  • Rain gear if needed
  • Water bottle
  • Bug spray
  • A towel if you plan to swim
  • Swimsuit or water-friendly clothing if you plan to swim
  • Instruments, songs, poems, or stories to share
  • Flow toys, fire toys, and fuel and fire safety gear
  • Creative adornments, body paint, face gems, festival-style fun
  • Anything you want for the late-night celebration
  • Anything that helps you feel more magical, comfortable, playful, or expressed

For campers

Everything on the day-guest list, plus:

  • Tent or vehicle camping setup
  • Sleeping bag or blankets
  • Pillow
  • Sleeping pad, air mattress, or car mattress
  • Flashlight or headlamp
  • Portable charger
  • Toiletries and any medications
  • Change of clothes for Sunday
  • Comfortable sleepwear
  • Snacks and food for Sunday
  • Cooler if needed
  • Trash bag for your campsite cleanup
  • Hammock if you like
  • Crafts to work on and games to play
  • Personal creative items
  • Festival or campout comfort items, and anything for rain

If you feel called to give

Registry

We are so happy you are here celebrating with us, yay! It means a lot to share our love with you all, and your support and excitement for us truly means the world!

Since we already have many of the physical things we need for our home, we made a registry out of experiences and life projects instead. Please know there is no pressure here. Being part of our lives and celebrating with us is already so nourishing! If you do feel inspired to support something here, we will receive it with so much gratitude, and we will think of you when we are enjoying the experience or working on the project you helped make possible. Thank you for loving us and celebrating this chapter with us. We love you!

A gift here might go toward:

HoneymoonHome improvementsPet care Retirement fundEmergency fundCar care Date nightsFamily vacationsCommunity spaces Other experiences and life projects

One simple fund, you choose the amount

There are no categories to pick through and no boxed gifts. Your contribution stays private, and you are welcome to leave us a note.

✦

Thank you, truly.

We will think of you every time we enjoy what you helped make possible.
